section.title: Overview
section.para: It is designed as a carrier-grade session synchronization backend for RTPEngine and transactional dialog state storage, featuring zero BGSAVE jitter, secondary O(log N) indexing, zero-allocation buffer decoding, 5-vector scatter-gather (writev) persistence, and connection pooling.

section.title: Tarantool Server Setup & Schema
section.para: The ndb_tarantool module requires a running Tarantool 3.x instance with the VoIP schema initialized. You can deploy the backend using any of the following methods:

section.title: Option 2: Minimal Lua Schema Initialization
section.para: If you run your own Tarantool server, add the following space and index definitions to your init.lua:
section.programlisting: -- Create rtpe_calls space (ID: 512) local calls = box.schema.space.create('rtpe_calls', { if_not_exists = true }) calls:format({ { name = 'call_id', type = 'string' }, { name = 'node_id', type = 'string' }, { name = 'state', type = 'string' }, { name = 'created_at', type = 'unsigned' }, { name = 'updated_at', type = 'unsigned' }, { name = 'expires_at', type = 'unsigned' }, { name = 'payload', type = 'any' }, }) calls:create_index('primary', { parts = { 'call_id' }, if_not_exists = true }) calls:create_index('by_node', { parts = { 'node_id', 'updated_at' }, if_not_exists = true, unique = false }) calls:create_index('by_expire', { parts = { 'expires_at' }, if_not_exists = true, unique = false })
section.para: Complete production templates, stored procedures, and TTL fibers are available in the open-source backend repository: https://github.com/lean1ee/tarantool-voip-backend.

section.title: server (string)
section.para: Specifies the Tarantool server connection details. Format can be either [srv_id]=[host]:[port] or key-value format addr=[host];port=[port];user=[user];pass=[pass];pool=[size].

section.title: host (string)
section.para: Default host or IP address for Tarantool server connection.

section.title: port (integer)
section.para: Default binary IProto TCP port.

section.title: user (string)
section.para: Tarantool authentication username.

section.title: pass (string)
section.para: Tarantool authentication password.

section.title: pool_size (integer)
section.para: Number of active IProto TCP connections per &kamailio; worker process.

section.title: connect_timeout (integer)
section.para: TCP socket connection timeout in milliseconds.

section.title: cmd_timeout (integer)
section.para: Socket query and stored procedure response timeout in milliseconds.

section.title: disable_time (integer)
section.para: Time in seconds to temporarily disable communication with an unreachable Tarantool instance.

section.title: allowed_timeouts (integer)
section.para: Number of consecutive errors or timeouts allowed before triggering node disabling.

section.title: init_without_tarantool (integer)
section.para: Allows &kamailio; to boot successfully even if the Tarantool instance is initially offline.
Executes a stored procedure on the Tarantool instance identified by srv_id.
Evaluates arbitrary Lua code directly inside the Tarantool server.

section.title: KEMI Bindings
section.para: The module exports high-performance KEMI Lua and Python functions:

listitem.para: KSR.tarantool.call(proc_name, params_json) - Calls a Tarantool stored procedure and returns the JSON string result.
KSR.tarantool.eval(lua_expr, params_json) - Evaluates arbitrary Lua code in Tarantool and returns the result.

section.title: Complete SIP Signaling & Media Proxying with RTPEngine
KEMI Lua Routing Script Example
section.programlisting:
-- KEMI routing logic with Tarantool function ksr_route_invite() KSR.rr.record_route()
-- Query Tarantool stored procedure local best_node = KSR.tarantool.call("select_optimal_node", KSR.pv.get("$ci")) if best_node then KSR.info("KEMI selected RTPEngine node: " .. best_node .. "\n") end
KSR.rtpengine.rtpengine_offer("replace-origin replace-session-connection") KSR.tm.t_relay() end
